Theorem
[Positive scalar lower bound for nonflat $\Rc \ge 0$ shrinkers (Theorem 27.53)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0050, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0051, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0052 ↗ cor:chow-iv-gradient-complete ↗ prop:chow-iv-scalar-lower-equality 1. ch27:27.53\group Nonnegative Ricci curvature

If a complete noncompact shrinker has $\Rc \ge 0$ and is not Ricci flat, then there is $\delta >0$ with $R\ge \delta $ everywhere. Along integral curves of $ abla f$, $R$ is nondecreasing; the proof uses the estimate $\langle abla f,\gamma '(r) angle \ge r/4-C_1-| abla f|(\widetilde O)$ and a backward-flow contradiction.
